es.title: ARIA — IA generativa para soporte SAP | Harol Guerrero Salgado

fallback.heading: ARIA — Asistente de soporte SAP con IA generativa
fallback.paragraph: ARIA responde dudas de SAP en español a partir de más de 13.000 SAP Notes, con Amazon Bedrock (Claude Haiku 4.5), Knowledge Bases sobre S3 Vectors y una arquitectura serverless en AWS. Proyecto de equipo para Arix Group: construí la interfaz de chat, el panel de fuentes, la capa de API y la documentación.

en.ogImageAlt: ARIA — Generative AI case study for SAP support

fallback.heading: ARIA — SAP support assistant with generative AI
fallback.paragraph: ARIA answers SAP questions in Spanish from more than 13,000 SAP Notes, using Amazon Bedrock (Claude Haiku 4.5), Knowledge Bases on S3 Vectors and a serverless AWS architecture. A team project for Arix Group: I built the chat interface, the sources panel, the API layer and the documentation.

fallback.paragraph: Este portafolio es mi proyecto personal: React, TypeScript y Vite en dos idiomas, un admin propio sobre Netlify Functions para editar todo el contenido, 15 workflows de GitHub Actions con Lighthouse, axe y Playwright, CV en PDF generado de los mismos datos y un resumen semanal por correo. fallback.paragraph: This portfolio is my personal project: React, TypeScript and Vite in two languages, my own admin on Netlify Functions to edit all the content, 15 GitHub Actions workflows with Lighthouse, axe and Playwright, a PDF résumé built from the same data and a weekly email digest. Its full technical documentation is at docs.hgsportafolio.site.
